# Test fixtures

The EPUB files here are unmodified Project Gutenberg editions, included so the tests run offline. They are in
the public domain in the United States; Project Gutenberg's licence is inside each file. Check the law of your
own country before reusing them.

| File | Project Gutenberg ebook | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `alice_epub2.epub` | #11, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland | the EPUB 2 to 3 upgrade and the end-to-end test |
| `pride_epub2.epub` | #1342, Pride and Prejudice | dialogue attribution and classification |
| `sherlock_epub3.epub` | #1661, The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes | a dialogue-heavy book |
| `mobydick_epub3.epub` | #2701, Moby Dick | heavy italics and a link-heavy table of contents |
| `warpeace_epub3.epub` | #2600, War and Peace | a large book with inline footnotes |
| `alice_kf8.azw3`, `alice_mobi6.mobi` | #11, converted with Calibre | Kindle input |

`pdnc_mini/` and `pdnc_pride_ch1/` are hand-made files in the format of the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus. They
are not taken from the corpus.
